title: Create task and start or schedule run
description: Create a task and start its first background run, or set `scheduled_at` for a one-off run within 30 days. Times without an offset use UTC. Confirm the returned time; execution starts at or after that time. Omit model fields to use saved defaults. Use `tasks-models-retrieve` before an explicit model choice. Set `description` to the agent's instructions. For code tasks, set `repository` to `organization/repo`. Omit `branch` to use the default branch. Check `run_error` if the run does not start. Poll `tasks-runs-list` or `tasks-runs-retrieve` for progress. If the response is lost, search for the task before you retry. A repeated call can create another task.

methodDocumentation.text: API for managing tasks within a project. Tasks represent units of work to be performed by an agent.

Create a task and start its first background run, or set `scheduled_at` for a one-off run within 30 days. Times without an offset use UTC. Confirm the returned time; execution starts at or after that time. Omit model fields to use saved defaults. Use `tasks-models-retrieve` before an explicit model choice. Set `description` to the agent's instructions. For code tasks, set `repository` to `organization/repo`. Omit `branch` to use the default branch. Check `run_error` if the run does not start. Poll `tasks-runs-list` or `tasks-runs-retrieve` for progress. If the response is lost, search for the task before you retry. A repeated call can create another task.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
Detail response for a task.

Reads from a frozen ``TaskDetailDTO`` produced by the facade. ``github_integration`` /
``github_user_integration`` are integration ids, ``signal_report`` is the report id, and
``latest_run`` nests the run-detail shape. ``created_by`` mirrors core ``UserBasicSerializer``.
